title: Minimax Optimality of Shampoo for Nonstationary Stochastic Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.16923v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We develop a comprehensive theoretical analysis of Matrix Shampoo for tracking time-varying optima in nonstationary stochastic optimization. We derive finite-horizon high-probability bounds for average tracking error that disentangle initialization, optimizer drift, momentum-induced drift penalty, stochastic noise, and adaptive preconditioning, with explicit dependence on momentum parameter \(\beta_1\) and stabilization parameter \(\varepsilon\). These bounds reveal an explicit drift--noise and stability--geometry tradeoffs: noise-dominated regimes favor larger $\beta_1$, which provides stronger first-moment averaging and greater suppression of gradient noise, whereas drift-dominated regimes favor smaller $\beta_1$, allowing faster adaptation to moving optimizer. Larger $\varepsilon$ reduces the preconditioner-perturbation term while weakening Shampoo's ability to exploit matrix geometry, thereby reducing adaptivity. We establish a match

translated_title: Shampoo算法在非平稳随机优化中的极小极大最优性
translated_abstract: 我们对矩阵Shampoo算法进行了全面的理论分析，用于追踪非平稳随机优化中随时间变化的最优解。我们推导了平均追踪误差的有限时域高概率界，该界清晰地分离了初始化、优化器漂移、动量引起的漂移惩罚、随机噪声以及自适应预条件化等各项影响，并显式依赖于动量参数β₁和稳定化参数ε。这些界揭示了显式的漂移—噪声权衡与稳定性—几何权衡：在噪声主导的情形下，较大的β₁更有利，因为它能提供更强的一阶矩平均和更大的梯度噪声抑制；而在漂移主导的情形下，较小的β₁更有利，使算法能够更快地适应移动中的最优解。较大的ε会减小预条件器扰动项，但同时会削弱Shampoo利用矩阵几何结构的能力，从而降低其自适应性。我们建立了匹配……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文对矩阵Shampoo在非平稳随机优化中追踪时变最优解的性能进行了全面理论分析，推导出分离初始化、漂移、噪声与自适应预条件化影响的有限时域高概率追踪误差界，揭示了动量参数β₁的漂移—噪声权衡与稳定化参数ε的稳定性—几何自适应性权衡，并证明了其极小极大最优性。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a comprehensive theoretical analysis of Matrix Shampoo for tracking time-varying optima in nonstationary stochastic optimization, deriving finite-horizon high-probability tracking error bounds that disentangle initialization, drift, noise, and adaptive preconditioning, revealing explicit drift–noise and stability–geometry tradeoffs governed by momentum parameter β₁ and stabilization parameter ε, and establishing its minimax optimality.
